chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ali bin Hassan, from Musa bin Bakr, from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) who said:
The jihad of the wife is goodness with the husband.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of a woman's jihad in Islam according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from Al-Kafi redefines 'jihad' for women as 'husn al-tab'all' (excellence in marital conduct), emphasizing that spiritual striving is achieved through ethical harmony and kindness within the domestic sphere. This interpretation underscores the theological value of the wife's role in maintaining family stability as a form of worship. It reflects the broader Shia emphasis on balancing ritual duties with social and familial ethics.
